items.title: 17.12 RLC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.12, Example 17.7 and an extra resonance example of ours (PDF 102-104).

blocks.text: Ek RLC series circuit lein jis ka AC source ki frequency badli ja sakti hai (Fig. 17.11(a)). Is ka impedance diagram Fig. 17.11(b) mein hai, jahan inductive reactance X_L = ωL aur capacitive reactance X_C = 1/ωC ek doosre ki opposite direction (ulti simt) mein hain (ek upar, ek neeche).
RLC series circuit ki impedance:

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke saath series mein R, L aur C, current I. Saath teen chhote graph: R ke liye Vo aur Io aik saath; L ke liye Vo quarter cycle aage; C ke liye Vo quarter cycle peeche. Ghoomta phasor daira XL ko +90 degree aur XC ko -90 degree par, 180 degree ke farq se dikhata. (b) Impedance tikon ABC: AB par R, BC par XL - XC, AC par Z, angle theta.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (a), (b): (a) RLC series circuit aur us ka phasor diagram; (b) RLC series circuit ka impedance vector diagram (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (a), (b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: X_L aur X_C ek doosre ki ulti direction (simt) mein hain (ek +90°, doosri −90°), is liye un ka farq X_L − X_C hi R ke saath milta hai: Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²). X_L bari ho to circuit RL jaisa, X_C bari ho to RC jaisa.
Zyada frequency par X_L = ωL, X_C = 1/ωC se bohat bari hoti hai; inductive reactance X_L dominant (ghalib) hoti hai aur circuit RL series circuit jaisa behave (bartao) karta hai.
Kam frequency par X_C = 1/ωC, X_L = ωL se bohat bari hoti hai; capacitive reactance X_C dominant hoti hai aur circuit RC series circuit jaisa behave karta hai (Fig. 17.11(b)).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in do jumlon mein X_L ko 'inductance' aur X_C ko 'capacitance' kehti hai. Sahi: X_L inductive reactance aur X_C capacitive reactance hai (dono ohm mein); inductance L aur capacitance C alag cheezein hain.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Neeche ceiling fan ki wiring ki tasveer hai (live wire, switch, running winding, capacitor ke saath starting winding, rotor) aur poochti hai: ceiling fan mein kaunsa AC circuit istemal hota hai?

blocks.alt: Ceiling fan ki wiring: live wire ON/OFF switch se guzarti hai; oopar wali wire mein running winding (stator) hai jo daen taraf se neeche neutral wire tak aati hai; doosri branch mein capacitor aur starting winding (stator) neeche neutral wire tak; beech mein rotor; aik teer single phase supply dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Brain teaser: ceiling fan ki wiring (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: ceiling fan mein kaunsa AC circuit hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Capacitor-start (split-phase) motor circuit. Starting winding ke saath series mein capacitor laga hai, is liye us ka current running winding ke current se phase mein aage khisak jata hai. Do windings ke alag phase wale currents mil kar rotating (ghoomta hua) magnetic field banate hain jo rotor ko ghumata hai.

blocks.text: In dono ke darmiyan ek frequency ωᵣ aati hai jis par X_L = X_C. Is halat mein RLC series circuit sirf resistor (R) wale circuit jaisa ban jata hai (Fig. 17.11(c)).

Is condition (halat) ko resonance kehte hain. Resonance par X_L aur X_C barabar aur opposite direction mein hain, is liye ek doosre ko cancel (khatam) kar deti hain. Resonance frequency fᵣ is condition se milti hai:

blocks.alt: (c) Aik horizontal teer R: XL = XC par sirf resistance bachti hai. (d) Current I aur frequency f: resonance frequency fr par tez peak, peak par dashed lakeer, axis se peak tak dohra teer aur dono taraf horizontal teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (c), (d): (c) XL = XC par RLC series circuit sirf resistance ki tarah; (d) XL = XC par resonance (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (c), (d) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: RLC series circuit ki key properties (khaas baatein)
Series RLC circuit aisa versatile circuit hai jise alag alag frequencies par khaas behaviour ke liye design kiya ja sakta hai; is liye electronics mein bohat kaam aata hai.
1. Impedance aur resonance: resonance par impedance sab se kam (Z = R) hoti hai, aur resonant frequency:
2. Current: resonance par impedance sab se kam hai, is liye current sab se zyada hota hai (Fig. 17.11(d)).
3. Phase angle: resonance par phase angle zero hai: voltage aur current in phase hain aur power factor 1 hai.

4. Damping: resistor current ki oscillations (jhoolna) ko damp karta hai (dheema kar ke khatam karta hai). Zyada resistance = zyada damping, oscillations jaldi khatam. Gari ke spring par pahiye ki motion (harkat) RLC series circuit jaisi hai: shock absorber motion ko damp karta aur energy kharch karta hai (resistance ki tarah), aur mass aur spring resonant frequency decide (tay) karte hain (Fig. 17.11(e)).

blocks.alt: Laal gari ka agla hissa. Agle pahiye ke oopar coil spring (shock absorber) hai aur neela dohra teer pahiye ki oopar neeche motion (harkat) dikhata hai. Pahiye ke hub se aik lakeer par 'Path of motion' likha hai. Neeche sarak hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.11 (e): Gari mein shock absorber motion ko damp karta (dheema karta) aur energy kharch karta hai, bilkul RLC circuit mein resistance ki tarah. Mass aur spring resonant frequency tay karte hain (kitab ki Figure 17.11 (e) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Spring aur gari ka mass mil kar aik khaas (resonant) frequency par jhoolte hain, jaise L aur C. Shock absorber is jhoolne ko jaldi khatam karta hai, jaise resistance R current ki oscillations ko damp karti hai.

5. Tuning aur filtering: RLC series circuits, khaas kar resonance par, radio receivers aur communication devices mein tuning (station pakarne) ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh band-pass filter ban kar ek khaas frequency range ke signals guzarne dete hain aur baqi ko attenuate (kamzor) kar dete hain.

6. Voltage amplification: resonance par inductor aur capacitor par voltage lagaye gaye voltage se kahin zyada ho sakta hai, kyunke un ke darmiyan current circulate karta (ghoomta) rehta hai. Ise voltage amplification kehte hain.
7. Power dissipation (power ka kharch): RLC series circuit mein power:

Ise true power (asal power) kehte hain. Sab se zyada power θ = 0 par kharch hoti hai, jo sirf resistor mein mumkin hai. Apparent power (zahiri power) sirf VI hoti hai (unit volt-ampere); power factor cos θ = true power / apparent power.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke apparent power 'VI cos θ ke barabar' hai. Sahi: apparent power VI (volt-ampere) hai; VI cos θ to true power hai (Eq. 17.27).

blocks.title: Example 17.7
blocks.problem: LCR series circuit mein inductor par 20 V, capacitor par 11 V aur resistor par 12 V hain. Kul voltage aur current ka phase difference, aur AC source ka Vᵣₘₛ nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: V_L = 20 V, V_C = 11 V, V_R = 12 V
θ = tan⁻¹(0.75) ≈ 36.8° (voltage current se aage, kyunke V_L > V_C)

blocks.alt: Aik hi point se teen teer: V_L seedha oopar, V_C seedha neeche aur V_R daen (right) taraf.
blocks.caption: Example 17.7: phasors V_L, V_C aur V_R (kitab ke sketch ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: V_R daen taraf aur V_L − V_C usi point se seedha oopar; resultant V_rms usi point se V_R ke oopar aik angle par.
blocks.caption: Example 17.7: V_R, V_L − V_C aur resultant V_rms (kitab ke sketch ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: V_L aur V_C ulti direction (simt) mein hain, is liye pehle un ka farq V_L − V_C = 9 V lete hain. Yeh V_R = 12 V ke saath 90° par hai, is liye resultant V_rms = √(12² + 9²) = 15 V, aur V_R se is ka angle θ ≈ 36.8° hai.

blocks.title: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi)
blocks.problem: L = 10 mH aur C = 1.0 μF wale series circuit ki resonant frequency nikalein.

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: X_L = X_C par resonance: fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC); Z = R, current sab se zyada, power factor 1.
True power = VI cos θ; apparent power = VI.
